title: A browser refresh returns to the screen the instructor was on
acceptance: Refreshing Safari on a class's detail screen or in Live returns to that class (and, in Live, to the class with the held position or a clear resume prompt), not the Classes home.
nextAction: Plan: the app has no router (App.tsx switches on pathname; Dashboard keeps navigation in component state). Decide between URL paths/hash for class detail and Live, or restoring the last screen from session storage. Owner decision on approach first.

evidence.summary: Owner noticed during the 2026-10-29 iPhone probe.
